content.ascii:
[R] Content revisions and publication
|
|-- DiagramRevision: immutable diagram, ancestry, and nodeRefs
|   |-- content: ASCII/hash and freeform or parsed-tree structure
|   |-- sourceContext: binding, mappings, captured evidence
|   `-- nodeRefs preserve proven logical identity across revisions
|
|-- create / revise / derive: validate and issue a frozen revision
|   `-- explicit base and conservative node correspondence
|-- revision store: retain / import / get / list revisions
|-- generation or supplied edit: candidate -> validate -> issue -> retain
`-- controller publication: install revision -> CanvasHistory.append
    `-- checkpoint binds diagram IDs to revision IDs; persistence flushes records

DiagramNode references a revision; presentation belongs to its placement.
Display mode, folds, highlights, and panels do not change bound content.
